decision.topic: k-surface dependency semantics and SDK ordering

immutableRefs.note: Approval intake and EPOCH-02 are read by digest only; application state lives here.

directionContract.rule: A kernel node does not declare dependsOn toward SDK or Edition scope; downstream layers depend on the kernel.
directionContract.provisionalContractBoundary: k-surface may publish a provisional projection contract; consuming it never reverses the recorded direction.

surfaceObservation.outOfScopeReason: KGA-G04 binds only be-sdk and stack-editions; L1 edges are not this decision's scope.

repairAuthority.note: Two of the eight kernel conflict edges are the k-surface edges; their repair is KGA-D07 work.

invariants: Recording the approved direction is not a gap closure; KGA-G04 stays open.
The registry keeps all ten decisions pending and unselected.
The live node universe stays at 650 and the 46/8/38 conflict split is unchanged.
PR-01 remains the only next-actionable queue item.
No planning artifact here is runtime implementation evidence.
nonGoals: change k-surface dependsOn or blocks, or any other edge
create, delete or mutate any generated node
reorder, renumber or re-status the base queue
mutate the closure authority, the EPOCH-02 chain or registry decisions
decide KGA-D03 registry ownership, KGA-D05 exit semantics or the KGA-D07 edge repair
write platform, runtime, app or module code
claim kernel/SDK/app readiness, release or deploy

rollback.trigger: the recorded disposition, immutable provenance digests, live conflict measurement or NO-GO boundary drifts
rollback.action: revert the decision-pack link, package gate and audit parent-gate mirror first, then this report with tests/kernelSurfaceDependencyOrderHandoff.test.ts as one shard
